# Wegenz Infinite Practice

> High-performance educational question simulator and CBT mock examination engine for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and NEET aspirants with 170,000+ authentic previous year questions.

Wegenz Infinite Practice provides unlimited custom practice sessions across 208 chapters with instant KaTeX math rendering, step-by-step solutions, and video explanations.

## Core Examination Tracks

- [Class 11th JEE Practice](https://wegenz.in/practice/11th_JEE): Dedicated practice track for Class 11 JEE Main & Advanced covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
- [Class 12th JEE Practice](https://wegenz.in/practice/12th_JEE): Dedicated practice track for Class 12 JEE Main & Advanced covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
- [Class 11th NEET Practice](https://wegenz.in/practice/11th_NEET): Dedicated practice track for Class 11 NEET covering Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology.
- [Class 12th NEET Practice](https://wegenz.in/practice/12th_NEET): Dedicated practice track for Class 12 NEET covering Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology.

## Capabilities & Architecture

- [Saved Bookmarks Hub](https://wegenz.in/practice/11th_JEE?bookmarks=open): Persistent offline question vault to bookmark challenging PYQs and practise them in focused custom sessions.
- [Web Manifest](https://wegenz.in/manifest.webmanifest): Progressive Web App manifest configuration for offline installability.
- [Sitemap](https://wegenz.in/sitemap.xml): Search engine indexing sitemap.
- [Robots Directives](https://wegenz.in/robots.txt): Crawler indexing policies.

## Features & Simulation

- **Dual Modes**: Exam Mode (timed simulation) and Quiz Mode (instant solution and video explanation per question).
- **Keyboard Navigation**: Full keyboard shortcut support for CBT test-taking (<kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>4</kbd>, <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowRight</kbd>, <kbd>B</kbd> for bookmark).
- **Fast KaTeX Typesetting**: High-contrast mathematical and chemical formula rendering in both Light and Dark themes.
